question.text: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: If <math><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is an odd function, then <math><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mrow><munderover><mo stretchy="false">∫</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></munderover><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></mrow></math> is an even function.

If <math><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is an odd function, then <math><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mrow><munderover><mo stretchy="false">∫</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></munderover><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></mrow></math> is also odd.

If <math><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is a periodic function, then <math><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mrow><munderover><mo stretchy="false">∫</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></munderover><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></mrow></math> is also periodic.

If <math><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is periodic, then <math><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mrow><munderover><mo stretchy="false">∫</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></munderover><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></mrow></math> is always non <math><mo>-</mo></math> periodic.

solution.text:
As, gx=∫0xftdt
⇒g-x=∫0-xftdt
Put t=-u
⇒dt=-du
∴g-x=-∫0xf-udu
∫0xfudu
(as f x is odd)
∴g-x=gx
Hence, gx is even.
Also, Consider gx=∫0xcos2⁡tdt
⇒gx=x2+sin⁡2x4
Which is non - periodic even though y=cos2⁡x is periodic
Also, if gx=∫0xcos⁡tdt
Then, gx=sin⁡x, which is periodic.
